stories.title: India’s AI opportunity is hiding beneath the index
stories.summary: India has lagged major markets as weaker AI exposure coincided with lower correlation to the global AI theme, highlighting the benchmark’s limited participation in the technology-led rally in recent years. AI-related stocks account for only 16% of MSCI India, well below the exposure seen in Korea, Taiwan, China and Japan. Goldman Sachs identifies 42 AI Enablers across power, data centres and semiconductors, with the cohort up 60% in 2026, even as the Nifty declined 12%. stories.title: Special swaps rake in $143.5 billion in forex inflows: FCNR(B) scheme leads with $133 billion
stories.summary: Banks mobilised $132.9 billion through FCNR(B) deposits under the RBI’s special forex swap window, taking total inflows, including ECBs and OFCBs, to $143.5 billion by September 18. The inflows are more than five times those raised under a similar 2013 scheme, with banks raising a significant portion in the final 10 days. While the FCNR(B) facility continues to support dollar inflows, rising global bond yields may weigh on further overseas borrowing through ECBs and OFCBs, which remains available until December 31.
